material.acceptance_criteria: Vendored piccolo builds its table hasher from fixed seeds (RandomState::with_seeds), the getrandom js shim in web/Cargo.toml is dropped if nothing else needs it, and two constructions of one host iterate one table in one order.
material.description: rust/vendor/piccolo/src/table/raw.rs:34,64 (hash_builder: ahash RandomState::new()); rust/crates/web/Cargo.toml feeds getrandom from JS for exactly this seed. Any Lua pairs over non-array keys differs per peer and per replay (spells.lua:214 and aegis.lua:42 are the live cases; controls.lua:597 already sorts).
